title: iPhone Duo research spike: posture, Split View, Duo Preview, outer display in Unity 6
summary: Before any Duo feature is designed, establish what iOS 27 exposes to a Unity app on iPhone Duo and how. Deliverable is a short research report with a feasibility call per selected feature; a throwaway prototype is welcome if a Duo or Xcode simulator is available.

acceptance_tests.test: research/duo/README.md answers, with citations and retrieval dates: how iOS 27 exposes fold posture and hinge angle to apps (API names, events, latency); whether Unity 6 surfaces them or a native plugin is needed; how Split View across the two displays behaves for a Unity app (resolution changes, safe areas, orientation callbacks); whether and how an app renders to the outer display while folded (Duo Preview behavior); the Apple Pencil input path in Unity for later.
A feasibility call per selected feature (M3-DUO-01, M3-DUO-02, M2-DUO-01): feasible in Unity / needs a native plugin / not feasible, each with an effort estimate and the risk that could stop it.
A throwaway Unity scene that logs posture changes and Split View resizes on the Duo simulator or device, with a short clip.

design: Design Skills rule 27 (no full-screen blur in play)

history.event: created by the Coordinator (Owner selection of iPhone Duo candidates 1–3 and App Store Connect key confirmation, AUTH #003)

research/duo/README.md (desk research, 11 sources retrieved 2026-09-29): hinge APIs (onHingeChange / UIHingeInteraction; rate + precision are system policy, latency undocumented; hinge for effects, reserved regions + ArrangementView for layout); no Unity binding → small native plugin; Split View = mid-session resolution/aspect changes, orientation not honoured on the inner display; outer display while folded = the app's display; both-displays via SwiftUI-only CameraCaptureAccessory (needs an active capture session; ARKit compatibility unknown); Pencil via Input System Pen later. Feasibility (AT-2): M3-DUO-01 needs a small plugin (~3–5 d), M3-DUO-02 feasible (~2–3 d), M2-DUO-01 obsolete under AUTH #020 (cancel or reframe → Owner). AT-3 prototype not possible without the Duo simulator/device. → in-review

notes: Runs early in M1 so M2 and M3 design work has the API facts. Does not gate the M1 exit test.
